messages:
Aisha (eng-sre): quick sync coming out of the Kestrel postmortem. Short RCA: repeated VPC flap events + on-prem NAT translation drift caused session pinning failures and triggered Dedicated isolation heuristics. We sketched fixes in the doc; now we need owners, short mitigations, timelines, and a durable recurrence plan for similar incidents.

Ben (eng-runtime): I can pick up the runtime mitigation: prefer KV-backed bindings when peer health is degraded and add sticky session fallback. Will do feature-flag + tests. ETA ~2w.

Marta (eng-platform): I'll build the preflight validator to detect asymmetrical NAT and missing static routes; plan to add a CI gate for Dedicated onboarding. ETA ~3w.

Pri (customer-success): Customer accepted a short maintenance window to apply interim mitigations (reduce idle timers + deprioritize flaky peer). They asked for rollback steps before the window and a post-maint summary within 2 hours.

infra-bot: maintenance scheduled: "Kestrel peering maintenance" 2026-05-04T01:00:00Z - 2026-05-04T01:30:00Z (ref: #maint-182345).

Aisha (eng-sre): Action items (please add tracker links/PRs back here):
```
- K-A1: Peer-flap detection & packet-capture hooks (owner: Aisha) due: 2026-05-10 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4501
- K-A2: Runtime KV fallback + sticky-session flag (owner: Ben) due: 2026-05-12 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4502
- K-A3: On-prem NAT symmetry validator + CI gate (owner: Marta) due: 2026-05-18 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4503
- K-A4: Interim maint + comms + rollback doc (owner: Pri) due: 2026-05-03 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4504
```

Ben (eng-runtime): adding quick failing unit test snippet to RD-4502 to illustrate the issue:
```
[2026-04-28T20:11:12Z] conn 0x9f: src=10.8.4.2 translated=54.12.8.1 mismatch -> session drop
```

Marta (eng-platform): uploaded validator prototype to RD-4503. CLI sample: `redwood-validate --check-nat-symmetry kestrel-config.yaml` will flag translation asymmetry. Planning to add this as a Dedicated onboarding blocker.

Aisha (eng-sre): I've added an automated alert: `if peer_bgp_down > 90s then page SRE` and a playbook stub in RD-4501. Also scheduling weekly follow-ups (Wednesdays 16:00 UTC) until all tickets are closed.

infra-bot: rollback artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-rollback/kestrel/rollback-2026-05-04.tgz. Docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/kestrel/rollback.

Pri (customer-success): I'll send pre-window comms with rollback steps and on-call contacts. Customer requested the post-maint summary by 03:30 UTC.

Ben (eng-runtime): priority during the window is K-A4 then K-A2. After that K-A1/K-A3. Will link PR to RD-4502 when ready. Ping me for pairing. :white_check_mark:

Aisha (eng-sre): final note: we should also add an incident recurrence section to the global isolation-runbook that lists NAT asymmetry as a common pattern and the short checklist for mitigation. I'll draft that and iterate. If blocked, DM me. :spiral_calendar:
